verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a fully autonomous, multi-step research process. After a brief scoping exchange, Marlin creates a research plan, then repeatedly forms hypotheses, gathers information, navigates the web and resolves contradictions for up to about eight hours. It explicitly positions this as more than summarization. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor-published claims and testimonials.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can pose a research question and get an autonomous multi-step investigation, not just a single-pass summary

citations.quote: Once you set a research topic, it works without further human input: repeatedly forming hypotheses, gathering information, navigating the web, and resolving contradictions on its own.
From ideation and data gathering to resolving contradictions and structuring the report, the AI autonomously executes the entire research process.
Sakana Marlin scales up inference-time compute to execute up to eight hours of continuous, autonomous reasoning.
Create a research plan based on the requested topic.
